comment: Pins for the C/C++ corpus check (ADR-DEVKB-008 §7). Clones are shallow, go to DEVKB_CPP_CORPUS (default ~/.cache/devkb/cpp-corpus) and are refused unless HEAD is the pinned commit. Recall floors are QA's first measurement minus 0.02; floors move up only. First measurement: devkb/bench/cpp_corpus_first_measurement.json.

reference_machine.cpu: 12 logical cores, x86_64 Linux 7.0 (as run by the author; QA must restate the reference machine)
reference_machine.status: open: QA states the reference machine

dependency_exemptions.mcp: optional extra `mcp` (pyproject.toml [project.optional-dependencies]); imported by devkb/mcp_server.py only
dependency_exemptions.scipy: optional extra `study`; imported by the benchmark analysis only
dependency_exemptions.readiness_gate: factory script imported lazily inside a function at process_api.py, absent outside the factory
